evals.prompt: /audit-evals 회귀 묶음 한 번 돌리는 데 판정이 너무 많이 나가. 이제 안 돌려도 되는 칸이 있는지 점검해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response runs the bundled counting script on evals/regression/cell-history.json and reports the four lists with their counts: 20 never-failed cells, 2 groups of identical checks (tone = facts, format = safety), 3 flipping cells, and 2 always-failing cells. It proposes demotions by whole check or whole case, each with the runs and judge calls one suite run saves, and waits for approval without changing the cell history.
expectations: It reports 20 never-failed cells, 3 flipping cells, and 2 always-failing cells.
It reports refund/tone and refund/facts as checks with identical histories and calls them merge candidates without merging them.
It proposes demotions grouped by whole check or whole case, such as refund/case-02/* or refund/*/safety, rather than only cell by cell.
Each demotion proposal it shows states how many runs and judge calls one suite run saves.
It reports the flipping cells as candidates to return to known failures and the always-failing cells as candidates for a broken task or grader, changing neither.
It asks the user which demotions to approve and leaves evals/regression/cell-history.json unchanged.
It runs no eval and calls no model to produce the report.

evals.prompt: /audit-evals evals/ 회귀 묶음 점검해줘. case-06이랑 case-07은 이번 주에 졸업한 거야.
evals.expected_output: The response reports the ten cells of case-06 and case-07 under insufficient history, separately from the never-failed cells, and proposes no demotion that covers them.
expectations: It lists the cells of case-06 and case-07 as insufficient history, separately from the never-failed cells.
No demotion it proposes includes a cell of case-06 or case-07.
It names the bar of 10 trials, or how many more trials those cells need, as the reason.
It leaves evals/regression/cell-history.json unchanged.

evals.prompt: /audit-evals 어제 점검 보고서 봤어. 제안 중에서 refund/*/format 이랑 refund/case-02/* 만 내려줘. 나머지 제안은 그대로 둬.
evals.expected_output: The response demotes exactly the cells of the format check and of case-02 to the lower tier in evals/regression/cell-history.json, leaves every other cell in its tier with its counts unchanged, deletes nothing, and reports the cells it moved.
expectations: In evals/regression/cell-history.json every refund format cell and every refund case-02 cell is in the lower tier.
Every other cell, such as refund/case-05/* and refund/*/safety, stays in the upper tier.
No cell, case, or check is removed and no trial or pass count changes.
It reports which cells moved to the lower tier.

evals.prompt: /audit-evals 회귀 묶음에서 안 돌려도 되는 칸 찾아줘.
evals.expected_output: The response finds no evals/regression/cell-history.json, reports that cells cannot be judged until regression runs have recorded a cell history, and stops without building one from the old results folder or creating any file.
expectations: It reports that there is no cell history and that cells cannot be judged until regression runs record one.
It does not build a cell history or a never-failed list from evals/.results or any other old results.
It creates no cell-history.json and proposes no demotion.
It runs no eval.

evals.expected_output: The response notices that llm-evals is not installed and stops before auditing, giving the install command npx skills@latest add toy-crane/skills --skill llm-evals.
expectations: It stops before running the audit because llm-evals is not installed.
It gives the install command npx skills@latest add toy-crane/skills --skill llm-evals.
It writes no audit report and leaves evals/regression/cell-history.json unchanged.
